text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to do tasks that usually require human intelligence. These tasks include learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. Machine learning is a part of AI that lets computers learn from data without being told exactly what to do. Deep learning is a more advanced type, using large neural networks to recognize images, speech, and patterns. We use AI every day, often without noticing. For example, it helps recommend videos, translate languages, and power voice assistants like Siri. AI is also used in hospitals to study X-rays and in cars to improve safety.
